title: Shopify's REST order update recalculates taxes when an unfulfilled order's shipping address changes, as of 2026-10
summary: As of Admin API version 2026-10, changing the shipping address of an unfulfilled order through the REST order update endpoint recalculates its taxes and totals against the new destination.
migrationNote: After updating a shipping address, read the order's tax lines and totals again instead of assuming they are unchanged.
